# Hiring your first product manager

## Transcript

Lenny (00:00:01):
When should a startup hire its first product manager?

Cy Fixture (00:00:09):
Hire the first product manager when the founders can no longer hold the whole roadmap in their heads, usually around twenty engineers. Look for curiosity and strong writing.
